text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: YAAAAAAAHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"KYAAAAAH! Yukino-chaaaan!" 
"She hauled it all the way!" "So cool!" 
"So that's the Grand Mikoshi Haul...!"

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
You did it, Yukino! 
Every single person here was praying for 
your success!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I could hear every single one of 'em. 
...They gave me so much strength!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
We will now begin distributing the hit 
arrows 
and hit targets from the Yabusame to 
everyone. 
Please accept them with our blessings.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: ――Scarlet-san!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I'll pray for your victory again and 
again. 
I'm going to keep cheering for you 
forever! 
I... I love you so much!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me. 
I'll always, always stay number one!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hast thou finished all the Yabusame, 
Lord Scarlet?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'll go change right away and head 
over. 
The festival isn't over just yet.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Mayanooo!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Scarlet-chan! 
I'm glad, you made it in time.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Do you have the tablet safe and sound?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Of course! 
Phew...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...――"O sacred steed of the Votive Dance, 
Mayano Top Gun. 
I, Daiwa Scarlet, present this offering 
unto thee."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"To enshrine the prayers offered up within 
thy form, 
here rests the token of bond dwelling 
within my name."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ..."I gratefully receive it."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: "Thy name is――"

"――And the winner is ×××××××××! 
For the first time in 37 years, the door 
of dreams has been unlocked!"

"What sheer competitive grit, ×××××××××!" 
"This is the true ××××××!" "The Scarlet 
Queen!"

“You were amazing! ×××××××××!” 
“××××××××× is truly something else!”

“Thank you for all your hard work. Rest 
easy now.” 
“Thank you for the dream――”
“――Daiwa Scarlet.”

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: …Did you see it too, Scarlet-chan?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Mayano…?  
Don't tell me you saw it too…?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I saw this super wondrous world. 
There were people calling out Maya's name…

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I had no idea where it was or what was 
going on. 
I didn't understand it, but――!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I really want to cherish that dream…! 
And you feel the same way, don't you, 
Scarlet-chan…?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course I do. 
Even if it was all just a dream or an 
illusion.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I want to cherish the dreams of those who 
called my name. 
I want to carry them proudly on my 
shoulders.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Let's go, Mayano. 
The closing dance is about to start…!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yeah――…!

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text: ――Horse girls and humans.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
…Since time immemorial, 
horse girls and humans 
have woven bonds between them.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text: And the very first rite they ever shared――

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
――was said to be 
the calling of each other's names.
